question:
Select the correct mirror image from the following options when the mirror is placed on the right side of the problem figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e6b7dfa815c708c7d220074912298695bc499c01fbf5f876c749f17bf8560bd.png]
solution:
The mirror image of the given figure is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88498e6e42b1b68d8bd5d4d875a135cd1f4ab888c5020863d475320050885415.png] 

Now we compare the given options:

Option 1) The pattern is inverted. It is incorrect.

Option 2) Half of the pattern is incorrect.

Option 3) The pattern matches completely.

Option 4) The pattern is not mirrored it is placed upside down. It is incorrect.

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
